articles.title: 🚨 Sugarcane Payment Crisis in UP: Minister Snubbed, Meeting Cancelled
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Why are sugarcane farmers still not getting their dues? UP Minister Anil Kumar, representing Rashtriya Lok Dal (RLD) in the BJP government, called a crucial meeting in Baghpat to address pending sugarcane payments.

body.html:
Why are sugarcane farmers still not getting their dues?

UP Minister Anil Kumar, representing Rashtriya Lok Dal (RLD) in the BJP government, called a crucial meeting in Baghpat to address pending sugarcane payments. But the meeting turned into a controversy:

❌ No-show by officials:
● District Magistrate, Deputy Cane Commissioner, and sugar mill officials all skipped the meeting.
● Even the local police failed to provide protocol or security to the minister.

😡 Minister Anil Kumar walked out in anger and cancelled the meeting, calling the attitude of officials disrespectful and irresponsible.

📆 A fresh meeting has now been scheduled for May 19.

This reflects growing tension within the state administration over farmer issues, and a possible lack of coordination between ministers and local officials.

articles.title: Girl Student Slapped 9 Times in 10 Seconds by Classmate’s Boyfriend; Video Goes Viral
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A disturbing incident has surfaced from Uttar Pradesh’s Muzaffarnagar, where a BA first-year student at SD Degree College was assaulted inside the college premises by her classmate’s boyfriend.

body.html:
A disturbing incident has surfaced from Uttar Pradesh’s Muzaffarnagar, where a BA first-year student at SD Degree College was assaulted inside the college premises by her classmate’s boyfriend. The attacker, identified as Amarjeet, was caught on video slapping the girl 9 times within 10 seconds, while hurling abuses at her. The victim was unable to defend herself and could be heard screaming and pleading for help.

The incident reportedly occurred on May 15, but only came to light after the video went viral on social media. A fellow student eventually intervened and stopped the assault.

Shockingly, when students tried to raise the issue, a professor allegedly dismissed it saying it was an “outside college matter.” However, after public outrage, a police complaint was finally filed.

Police have stated that the assault stemmed from a personal/family dispute, and assured that appropriate action has been taken.

This horrifying act raises serious questions about student safety, college accountability, and the slow response of authorities.

articles.title: New Ashok Nagar RRTS Station Damaged by Storm; Operations Halted Until Further Notice
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A section of the steel roof at New Delhi’s New Ashok Nagar station, part of the Delhi-Ghaziabad-Meerut RRTS (Namo Bharat) corridor, was damaged on Saturday due to a sudden windstorm and heavy rain.

body.html:
A section of the steel roof at New Delhi’s New Ashok Nagar station, part of the Delhi-Ghaziabad-Meerut RRTS (Namo Bharat) corridor, was damaged on Saturday due to a sudden windstorm and heavy rain.

The National Capital Region Transport Corporation (NCRTC) has halted operations at the station as a precaution. It will remain closed to the public until safety inspections and repairs are completed. Fortunately, no injuries have been reported.

In its official statement, NCRTC said:

“Due to an intense windstorm on Saturday, a portion of the tin roof at the New Ashok Nagar Namo Bharat Station was damaged. As a precautionary measure, operations at the station were immediately stopped.”

A detailed investigation is underway to determine the cause and ensure corrective measures are implemented to prevent future incidents.

Currently, 55 km of the corridor (New Ashok Nagar to Meerut South) is operational with 11 stations. The full 82 km corridor is expected to be operational by end of this year.

articles.title: Uttarakhand: Helicopter with AIIMS Rishikesh doctors crashes during Kedarnath rescue — All safe
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: An air ambulance helicopter that arrived in Kedarnath to rescue a female devotee met with an accident during the operation. The pilot managed to make a timely emergency landing, saving the lives of all on board.

body.html:
An air ambulance helicopter that arrived in Kedarnath to rescue a female devotee met with an accident during the operation. The pilot managed to make a timely emergency landing, saving the lives of all on board.

A team of doctors from AIIMS Rishikesh was inside the helicopter at the time of the incident. During landing, a part of the helicopter broke, but no injuries were reported. The female devotee was being rescued as part of the Char Dham Yatra medical emergency response.

The incident highlights the risks faced by medical teams in high-altitude rescue operations and the quick thinking of the pilot that averted a tragedy.

articles.title: 🚨 Kozhikode: Woman narrowly escapes lorry accident — Miraculous survival caught on CCTV
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a shocking incident this morning in Perangalam, Kozhikode, a woman named Aswathy had a miraculous escape after a lorry suddenly rolled backward on an incline and crashed into her two-wheeler.

body.html:
In a shocking incident this morning in Perangalam, Kozhikode, a woman named Aswathy had a miraculous escape after a lorry suddenly rolled backward on an incline and crashed into her two-wheeler.

🕢 The accident occurred around 7:30 am near CWRDM, on the road from Peringalam Angadi to Medical College.
🚛 The lorry, loaded with Holobricks, reportedly suffered a brake failure and rolled back, slamming into Aswathy’s scooter.
💥 She was thrown clear of the scooter, landing behind the lorry — narrowly avoiding being crushed.
🌳 The lorry eventually stopped after hitting a roadside tree.
🏥 Locals rushed her to the hospital; she sustained only minor injuries to her hand.

📹 The full extent of the accident and her lucky escape came to light only after CCTV footage went viral.
